t: What patterns would you like to buy?
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
By studying the past we can shape our future. That is why my work is so important. By helping me to uncover the world's mysteries, you are helping the Empire!

Money? Hmm...
Hand it over and I'll give you the book! I'll be honest, I'm ashamed whenever I look at that poor sap... Who knew the book was so valuable to him? I sure didn't!
What? What do you need? I don't know anything. I'm clear! I haven't heard anything about a book! Err... oops!
May the blessings of the Trinity Church be with you! How can I help?
This is not a game. I will expose you to considerable danger. You need to drink a potion of power first.
I dare say that you will be able to defeat the monster. May the Light guide you!
Oh I see. Okay... Hm, the seal isn't broken... Good. Here's another package for you. Bring it to Vera Chonkina. Be quick about it and make sure you don't look inside!
Hello. Are you looking for me?
Got it. Let's see what Pravdin wants from me... Wow! I didn't expect something like that. Well, I guess it's necessary. Here's your new package. Please bring it to Pavel Bogdanov.
What? Do you need something from me?
Oh, I've been expecting you... Let's see... What, A7?! My last triple-decker... How dare you, Chonkina! Ugh. Please deliver this package to Verigin at once. He's going to be so upset...
Citizens of the Empire, come closer and look at this wonderful Gibberling! Even three of them!

Oh, you are on our side? Hm, I guessed that!
So, about that naked woman... I've never seen her, but I've heard the discussions.They say that she has wings and can fly. Amd moreover, she trembles her wings in the wind... in her own way! She's confusing minds!
I've never seen her, but I've heard the discussions!
What do you need? How can I help you this time?

Hm... I wonder if each person whom I meet works for the Council...
Well, I've changed the topic.
Yes, I've heard this legend. To be honest it haven't impressed me - the legend about black plumber is more interesting. What about the Temptress, I can analyze gossips and contradictions and say that she is not naked. That's all what I know.
Franky, I'm not interested in it.
Let your way be lighten with Light of Nezeb, Skrakan and... Tensess!

You are in time, my colleague!
Yesterday I've managed to find out some details about that Tempter. Several my students from Church reserve school told me that they were on the Old Square staring at her. I've written a report, do not wory about that. They have seen her on the building area! Yes! In that place where the building of SOSD - Social Order Supervision Department - will stand. A real loke of fate!
Seeking for advice? Oh, here it is. Don't be intrusive! If a lady doesn't feel like hopping into your arms, do not persist, or she may take you for a rude fellow!
What would I advise? Meet a new lady with caution! Should you try to go straight ahead, she may give you a slap.
Ladies should be treated with a gentle hand! We are delicate creatures, with frail bodies and hearts...
A gallant chevalier will stand by his only soul mate and never do her harm. Remember that ladies are jealous, and they have sharp claws!
Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
Seeking for advice? Well, here it is. When your sweetheart is near, don't ever utter a coarse or slangy word. Be a lady! A boy will never fall in love with a rude girl!
Here's my advice: when you hop into his arms, give him a hug and a languish sigh... and he's all yours!

What would I advise? Do not ever argue with him. Let him think he's the one to rule. But remember that it's not you who wants to be held, it's him who wants to hold you in his arms! You just have the kindness to assent!
My advice is quite simple. When you're in somebody's arms, keep quiet and don't start a dispute. Otherwise there's always a risk of finding yourself on the ground!
Sorry, I can't help you with that. Ask other Holiday Committee Officials.
The shackles are broken! New affections are waiting for you.
So, do you agree to pay the tax to register your legal marriage?
Excellent! Perfect! I'll prepare your ship in 5 minutes.
What do you want to know?
Congratulations! Your ship is ready to fly.
I am happy to give you a progress report. If you'd like to speed things along, ask me about the work being done on your ship.
Perfect! I'll make arrangements to start the construction right away. It's quite a long process, but I can tell you how to speed it up.

Demonology is a school of magic just like any elemental one. Or witchcraft, mysticism, necromancy...

The Church, of course, tried to impose penance: how dare we practice our foul arts! And rub elbows with demons to boot? They fuss over their Light like it’s the only thing that matters... Well, it’s their right as the high and mighty. But we’ll get even.

The Church wants you to eliminate demons? Wonderful. You’ll use their own weapons against them. Remember: demons are not our allies. They are no better than lab rats. Demons are a tool that will take us to a world of new magical opportunities, nothing more.
What do you need so much suspension for? Are you drinking it, or what? Alright, take it, before I change my mind!
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Sivoyar Zablosky, teacher of alchemy, at your service. I am here to use my expertise for the glory of Novograd! How can I help?

Alchemy... The greatest art! An intricate process of creating magic potions using simple herbs! Our goods can save lives or end it. Can you think of anything more useful? I certainly can't!
If you decide to join the noble brotherhood of alchemists I can sell you everything you need. A training book and tools should be enough to get any new alchemist started.

After using the alchemic mortar, place the following ingredients inside: herbs with the required properties and auxiliary substances that you can buy from me.
The properties of the ingredients used must form a harmonious combination. If you can ensure that, you'll get a potion whose effect depends directly on how well-matched the properties are. Yet the brewing process can result in a failure. You need to be ready for that and not lose hope.
By increasing your skill level, you'll gain access to new, more sophisticated and powerful formulas. Try making exactly these potions: the more sophisticated the formula, the greater the increase in your skill. However, making potions of levels surpassed long ago won't help your development. Your skill level depends on your character level as well: you can't become a high-class master if you stop developing.

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It’s doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can’t use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction!
Remember to use only high quality equipment. Upgrade it whenever possible. This will enable you to brew over one potion at one attempt. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!
Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don’t let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!

Vlad Kononov, blacksmith. Do you know what a blacksmith is? They are the embodiment of strength, agility, and dexterity! I'm telling you, I can hit even a flea! You have no idea how much armor I've made. The whole League Army wears my armor! And what are you doing here? What is it that you need?

Blacksmithing? It's a real art, believe me! You can't just wave your hammer - you need to break the material and occasionally your fingers! But if you work well, healers, warriors, and paladins will all be asking for your help!
If you want to become a blacksmith, talk to me. I have a book and some tools you can buy.

No one but us blacksmiths can make plate armor. Also, we possess the art of forging rings. But first you'll have to practice making shields and various household implements.
Now, to the craft. Use a mobile forge to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. You can buy coal for your work from me. Use a pick to extract ore that should then be cast in the molds you need. As for rivets, chains, heeltaps and spikes, those can be obtained by fighting enemies.
The forging process is simple: you create five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and reforge the rest. You can only reforge each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you craft. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you. The highest available skill level in blacksmithing equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics. Also, we can create tools to work with equipment pieces and staples - you will need those at the highest development level.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while. Keep in mind, though, that retroform affects neither ore nor the goods made from it.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
If you got away with a smaller number of reforges, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try making epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every blacksmith decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Hi! How are you? Yes, we are the best leatherworkers in town! We're guessing this is the reason you're here. So what would you like to learn?

Oh, you wanna be my competitor? Well I'm not afraid of you! Leather armor is in high demand by scouts, wardens, and psionicists! There's an endless supply of orders.
Now there's no point in wasting time. I have a special training book and a set of tools you can buy. They're pretty cheap, so you should buy some and get started immediately!

No one but us leatherworkers can craft leather outfits. Plus, we can make earrings.
Now, about the process itself. Use a leatherworker's box to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The ropes required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Clasps, laces, fringe and insets can be used as they are. As to leather fragments, you'll have to cut them with pincers first.
The process is simple: you make five parts, check their quality, keep the good ones and retailor the others. You can only retailor each part twice, and you work on at least two parts at a time.
If all parts are of equal quality, you'll get an item of that same quality. If the quality is uncommon, you'll even get two items. If not, you'll get the item anyway, but it won't be as good as it could be.
You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will be increased and new blueprints will be available to you.
The highest available skill level in leatherworking equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow crafting items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. They will allow you to craft items for sale to other heroes, higher-level items or even relics.
And most importantly: we can create Glyphs! Fight enemies at the Wild Shore and in the Astral to get required reagents. In order to create Glyphs of the highest quality, you will have to convert your Inspiration points into Illumination points. When the Illumination progress of a Glyph recipe reaches its maximum, you will be able to improve the quality of the produced Glyph.
By the way, if you ever need low-level components, you can use Retroform that you can buy from me as well. Don't worry, a single vial will last for a while.

The result largely depends on how lucky you are. If you are lucky, you'll make an item of rare or even epic quality. Some tricks of our craft will let you considerably increase your chances.
First of all, work on improving your tools. This will allow you to get rid of faulty parts, reforge one part at a time, increase the maximum number of reforges to three, and even stimulate your inspiration. With your tools improved, half of the parts you make will be uncommon, a third will be rare, and only one-sixth of them will be epic. Upgrades can be bought from me.
If you got away with a smaller number of retailoring attempts, the leftover material will be enough to make an extra item of the same quality.
You can try and make epic items or craft 2 to 3 uncommon items at a time, or you can choose the golden mean and get a pretty good chance to make rare items. Every craftsman decides for himself as to which strategy to choose.
Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
Nice to meet you. My name is Valentina de Ardeur and I teach all the up and coming tailors in the League. I can teach you everything you need to know, from taking measurements to sewing on buttons!

Describe tailoring? How can anyone describe a sunrise? How can anyone describe a dancing girl? They must be seen.
However, I will say something. My main clients are mages and necromancers, who need freedom, not defense, to fight. And believe me, they are all sharp dressers and don't want to wear rags! Only us tailors can solve this very important issue!
I am not afraid of competition, like some of my colleagues. And I freely sell a manual and instruments. If you will resolve to study this craft, you will need to buy them from me.
However, if you don't like tailoring, then talk to other schoolmasters. For example, Raw family, who are experts in tanning hides. You can find them in the Gibberling District.

No one but us tailors can craft clothes from fabric or make cloaks. Besides, we possess the knowledge how to make pectorals and necklaces.
Now, about the process itself. Use a sewing kit to learn the list of blueprints available and prepare the right components. The threads required for your work can be bought from me. You'll get the other components by fighting enemies. Embroidery, lace, buttons and beads can be used as they are, while fabric rolls have to be cut with scissors first.

You'll gain experience for each item you make. When you've gained enough experience, your skill level will increase and new blueprints will be available to you.
The maximum available level of tailoring equals your character level.
Keep in mind that, as your skill level increases, you only gain access to the simplest blueprints that allow making items for personal use. But there are other, more sophisticated and expensive blueprints that you'll have to buy or obtain by yourself. Read the manual. You will need a set of tools for your work. You can buy them all from me.
I'm Zoritsa Kovaleva, I teach weaponsmithing. You won't find sharper blades and more powerful wands than those I make at any fair!

After you obtain a valuable item, you can use scissors or pliers to disassemble the item into its individual components. The quality of the item that you disassemble will determine the quality of the materials that you receive. The components are generally used by tailors and leatherworkers to make new gear.
Every time you successfully disassemble an item, your skill level will increase. At higher skill levels you have a higher chance to receive more valuable items. Finally, you should know that if your overall level isn't high enough, you won't be able to increase your disassembling skill past a certain point.
You'll have to read the manual, and you'll need tools for your work. You can buy it all from me.

Let's see I need some more belladonna and anise... and some better quality aloe...
Oh, sorry! I didn't notice you there. My name is Mathilde de Grandeur, herbalism trainer, at your service!

Collecting herbs is the most exciting and profitable work! Exciting because you always need to be attentive and stick your nose everywhere, to find rare herbs and roots. Profitable because alchemists are prepared to die for the ingredients that you bring them and will pay any price! This is what herb collection is all about!
Are you still thinking of something else? Don't! Simply buy a manual and equipment from me and you will have a foundation for wealth and popularity!

All of these people wandering around aimlessly are interrupting our thoughts... They think that mining is a piece of cake, but it's an art you know! And we are the masters of it!

Are you still here? Hm... Well, let's talk.

Are you interested in mining? Well... do you have strength to investigate fields, mountains and caves in the search of ore? Are you ready to fight with wild beasts and cruel bandits that stand between you and your rocks? Are you ready to haggle with blacksmiths, tailors and leatherworkers over prices to get as much money as possible... Hm, then maybe we'll tell you our secrets...
Ah, I can see the enthusiasm in your eyes! Well, if you're interested in what we just said then we can sell you a training manual and some tools.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Here you are! You can always ask for more, if you need.
Is he playing up or something? If he wanted to help, he should have sent us food!

What? Five silver? Hm... Okay!
I don't know why I stole that book. The Astral controlled me, I swear! I just saw it lying on a bench and I took it, I had no idea... I'll be glad to get rid of it!
What? I know nothing, I've seen nothing, I've heard nothing, I've taken nothing! I'm not nervous! Not suspicious! I know no books! Oops... I shouldn't have said that!

Runes can be removed from one item and sold or inserted into a different item. To do this, you'll need to buy a special removal pick that I can sell you. However, you must remember that every time you remove a rune, it becomes weaker. There's also a small chance that it'll be completely ruined.
I recommend obtaining a more advanced removal pick or grabbing some Rune Removal Seals from the Allods Boutique to safely remove runes. It's a small price to pay to protect such a valuable item.
Runes of a single type and level can be combined to create a more powerful rune of that same type. To do this, you'll need to buy a special welder, gold dust, and crystal chips. You can buy the welder and the gold dust from me. Crystal chips can be obtained in the Allods Boutique, auction house, or by trading with other players.
Runes must inserted into special slots. Keep in mind that not every piece of equipment has slots. However, you can always make a slot yourself with the help of an engraving kit. You can also make existing slots bigger with an engraving kit. You can find various different types of engraving kits in the Allods Boutique as well.

Good question! Know that the rune not activated can be sold at Auction House. But as soon as you use its powers, the rune becomes bound to you.
Don't forget it when you combine the runes. If at least one bound rune is used in the combining, the resulting rune will bind to you too!
Exchange all old instrument for chips
We are the masters of runes. We know everything there is to know about them and we'd be delighted to share this knowledge with you!
Hello, hero! Do you know how much longer I'm going to be stuck here? I realize now that I love life more than the peaceful calamity of the Afterlife...
Mirra? For me? Thank you! To be honest, I've been getting quite tired of this dreary stone bag.
This place does have a certain deathly charm about it. However, after spending some time here, I am beginning to understand that I prefer serving the Empire to staying in otherworldly peace.
Thank you! I will return to work as soon as I can. As the Imperial motto goes: "Do or die!"
It's dark and gloomy and scary in here! Mommy... We want to go home!
Oh, is that for us? Thank you! Now we can get out of here quicker!
Sniff... sniff... I don't like it here... It's so depressing here...
Thank you! Thank you! Ooh, I will see the sun again soon!
Vsemil thinks it's funny? I'm starving here! I ain't gonna do anything until he sends some food!
Has Vsemil sent you? That's right on time.
Happy Spring! Have you come from Vsemil?
I report: situation critical! I'm running out of cards! And my volunteers leave all the time! I need more, now!
Not now. I’ll need sturdy guys with brooms tomorrow morning. I need to clean up a lot.
Seeking for advice? Oh, here it is. Don't be intrusive! If a lady doesn't feel like jumping into your arms, do not persist, or she may take you for a rude fellow!
What would I advise? Meet a new lady with caution! Should you try to go straight ahead, she may give you a slap.
Ladies should be treated with a gentle hand! We are delicate creatures, with frail bodies and hearts...
A gallant chevalier will stand by his only soul mate and never do her harm. Remember that ladies are jealous, and they have sharp claws!
Seeking for advice? Well, here it is. When your sweetheart is near, don't ever utter a coarse or slangy word. Be a lady! A boy will never fall in love with a rude girl!
Here's my advice: when you hop into his arms, give him a hug and a languish sigh... and he's all yours!

What would I advise? Do not ever argue with him. Let him think he's the one to rule. But remember that it's not you who wants to be held, it's him who wants to hold you in his arms! You just have the kindness to assent!
My advice is quite simple. When you're in somebody's arms, keep quiet and don't start a dispute. Otherwise there's always a risk of finding yourself on the ground!
Hi! I'm the bath house attendant. How can I help you?
Well, you had enough time to change your mind. But as far as I can see, you are not going to fall back.

Ahem... Marriage is not about haste and hurry... Especially when talking about money! You don't have money to pay the tax!
Come back when you are ready for a serious relationship!
Great! Now nothing is preventing you from being happy together!
So, do you agree to pay the tax to register your legal marriage?

I didn't think there would be anyone courageous enough to come here after my death. My soul has been captured by Tep's and become a prisoner of this temple forever. But then again, I suppose it's better to be a fleshless ghost than a living corpse.
We were ambushed as soon as we entered the temple. My people fought bravely but we were outnumbered.
This new evil is merciless and the undead multiply by the day. Their master is a Great Mage to the Zem people. If he is not stopped, this entire allod will turn into one massive graveyard and that would be just the start of this blight. I cannot stop Tep but I believe in you, your strength, intelligence, and courage. Finish what I started and save our world!
Goodbye! Remember me!
This is trouble, but all the same she is my wife. I must think about what to do.
Finally, medicine! The more potions the better!
Who's this? What do you want?
I kind of doubt that this will work, but I might as well try...
And what is that made of? You're not sure?! Well, alright, give it here anyway...
Alright, that's enough! Don't kill the wolf! You are serving the wrong power. You've been played for a patsy.

I am but an animal, but I know what's going on. I can smell it - the air reeks of horror, the ground shudders under my paws, the bones of an ancient king are turning over in their grave. My eyes also observe your stupidity. Instead of hunting me, you should be saving the soul!
He who talks loudly about Valir roots is in fact involved in dark and ghastly deeds and is to blame for much evil that has descended upon our land. It isn't me you should be hunting! If your mind is not able to grasp all this, go and seek the help of he who brings Light.
Take this horn, sound it and I shall come running to your aid! I am ready to stand and fight at your side!
We shall meet again!
